name: primary_serving_comparison
scope: Measured marker-free output-delivery metrics. Not sustainable capacity. Token cold graph captures confound the mechanism comparison.

name: primary_paired_ratios
scope: Measured paired start-level ratios. Confidence intervals do not treat tokens as independent samples.

name: instrumented_idle_gap_histogram
scope: Measured D-stage kernel gaps in perturbed runs. Not qualified clean capacity.

name: full_prompt_continuation_costs
scope: Measured CUDA Event enclosures. No clean online speedup claim.

name: native_old_new_observed_timeline
scope: Same primary arrival seed. Host observations only. Blank space is not physical GPU idle.

name: recovery_GPU_clock_enclosure_timeline
scope: Separate CUDA Event diagnostics. Enclosures can include idle time. This is not a physical kernel-idle trace.

name: recovery_actual_host_comparison
scope: Same selected request across matched arrival runs. Host records only. Other-source activity is pale orange. No invented physical idle.

name: recovery_serving_comparison
scope: Measured marker-free N128 recovery starts. Absolute SLO and Native-relative tail comparisons are distinct.

name: recovery_budget_vs_actual_loop_count
scope: Host-observed online budget and exact committed suffix depth. Not measured physical idle.

name: recovery_completion_prediction_error
scope: Measured host completion and modeled prediction. No guaranteed completion or GPU occupancy claim.

name: recovery_native_zero_loop_token_timeline
scope: Independent same-arrival runs. Host observations only. No invented GPU kernel or idle bars.
